description: Returns the account info and associated stake for all the voting accounts in the current bank.

parameters.name: object
parameters.description: The configuration object with the following fields:

sub_parameters.name: commitment
sub_parameters.description: The level of commitment required for the query. The options include:

sub_parameters.name: votePubkey
sub_parameters.description: (optional) Only return results for this validator vote address (base-58 encoded)

sub_parameters.name: keepUnstakedDelinquents
sub_parameters.description: The boolean value that determines whether or not to filter out delinquent validators with no stake

sub_parameters.name: delinquentSlotDistance
sub_parameters.description: Specify the number of slots behind the tip that a validator must fall to be considered delinquent. The parameter is passed as an integer and it's not recomended to specify this argument

result.description: A JSON object of current and delinquent accounts, each containing an array of JSON objects with the following fields:

result.current.description: The current account with the following fields:

result.current.activatedStake.description: The stake, in lamports, delegated to this vote account and active in this epoch. Represented as an u64 integer

result.current.commission.description: The percentage (0-100) of rewards payout owed to the vote account

result.current.epochCredits.description: The latest history of earned credits for up to five epochs, as an array of arrays containing: epoch, credits, previousCredits

result.current.epochVoteAccount.description: Boolean value, whether the vote account is staked for this epoch

result.current.lastVote.description: Most recent slot voted on by this vote account

result.current.nodePubkey.description: The validator identity as base-58 encoded string

result.current.rootSlot.description: The current root slot for this vote account

result.current.votePubkey.description: The vote account address as base-58 encoded string

result.delinquent.description: The delinquent account with the following fields:

result.delinquent.activatedStake.description: The stake, in lamports, delegated to this vote account and active in this epoch. Represented as an u64 integer

result.delinquent.commission.description: The percentage (0-100) of rewards payout owed to the vote account

result.delinquent.epochCredits.description: The latest history of earned credits for up to five epochs, as an array of arrays containing: epoch, credits, previousCredits

result.delinquent.epochVoteAccount.description: Boolean value, whether the vote account is staked for this epoch

result.delinquent.lastVote.description: Most recent slot voted on by this vote account

result.delinquent.nodePubkey.description: The validator identity as base-58 encoded string

result.delinquent.rootSlot.description: The current root slot for this vote account

result.delinquent.votePubkey.description: The vote account address as base-58 encoded string
